name: v0.7.0
body:
## We're pleased to announce QuPath v0.7.0!

* For more details, check out the [the changelog](https://github.com/qupath/qupath/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) - or the longer, auto-generated list of changes below.
* For questions and discussions, please use [the Scientific Community Image Forum](https://forum.image.sc/tag/qupath).
* For bug reports, please follow the template on [GitHub issues](https://github.com/qupath/qupath/issues).

<details>
<summary>Auto-generated changelog</summary>

* Avoid empty tooltips in grid view by @petebankhead in https://github.com/qupath/qupath/pull/1952
* Don't open servers to immediately close them by @petebankhead in https://github.com/qupath/qupath/pull/1959
* Dependency & changelog updates by @petebankhead in https://github.com/qupath/qupath/pull/1962

* Fixing tests where n might potentially be NULL by @zindy in https://github.com/qupath/qupath/pull/1967

## What to download
**See the [installation instructions](https://qupath.readthedocs.io/en/0.7/docs/intro/installation.html) - this explains what to do if security settings prevent QuPath being installed!**

* For **Windows** (two options, functionally the same)
  * [`QuPath-v0.7.0-Windows.msi`](https://github.com/qupath/qupath/releases/download/v0.7.0/QuPath-v0.7.0-Windows.msi) - if you want a standard Windows (local) installer
  * [`QuPath-v0.7.0-Windows.zip`](https://github.com/qupath/qupath/releases/download/v0.7.0/QuPath-v0.7.0-Windows.zip) - unzip it and double-click QuPath-v0.7.0.exe (no further installation needed)
* For **Mac** (two options, depending upon processor)
  *  [`QuPath-v0.7.0-Mac-arm64.pkg`](https://github.com/qupath/qupath/releases/download/v0.7.0/QuPath-v0.7.0-Mac-arm64.pkg) - for Macs using Apple Silicon. This runs faster & is recommended for most users, but lacks support for a small number of file formats through Bio-Formats (particularly .czi with jpeg-xr compression & .ndpis).
  * [`QuPath-v0.7.0-Mac-x64.pkg`](https://github.com/qupath/qupath/releases/download/v0.7.0/QuPath-v0.7.0-Mac-x64.pkg) - for Macs with Intel Processors *or* Apple Silicon (M1/M2)
* For **Linux**
  * [`QuPath-v0.7.0-Linux.tar.xz`](https://github.com/qupath/qupath/releases/download/v0.7.0/QuPath-v0.7.0-Linux.tar.xz) - use `chmod u+x /path/to/QuPath/bin/QuPath` to make the launcher executable.
